Name: Gog, Son of Shemaiah
Summary: Son of Shemaiah and father of Shimei in Reuben's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:4: Son of Shemaiah and father of Shimei in Reuben's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Gog stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
